about.page_subtitle: Learn about our story, mission, and the team behind HIMA.
about.story_p1: HIMA Electromecánica was born from a passion for engineering and a commitment to excellence. Founded by professionals with over two decades of experience in the electromechanical sector, our company has grown to become a trusted benchmark for highly complex projects in Costa Rica.
about.story_p2: From our first residential projects to the large industrial installations we carry out today, we have always upheld the same principles: technical rigor, on-time delivery, and personalized attention to each client.
about.mission_text: To provide comprehensive and sustainable electromechanical solutions that exceed our clients' expectations, ensuring safety, efficiency, and durability in every project.
about.vision_text: To be the leading electromechanical company in Central America, recognized for innovation, service quality, and the positive impact we have on the communities where we operate.
about.value_integrity_desc: We act with honesty and transparency in every interaction with clients and partners.
about.value_excellence_desc: We hold ourselves to the highest technical and service standards in every project.
about.value_innovation_desc: We adopt modern technologies to deliver more efficient and sustainable solutions.
about.value_safety_desc: The safety of our team and clients is our absolute top priority.
about.team1_bio: Electrical engineer with 22 years of experience in large-scale industrial and commercial projects.
about.team2_bio: Specialist in air conditioning and ventilation systems, ASHRAE-certified, with projects in 5 countries.
about.team3_bio: Expert in PLCs, SCADA, and industrial control systems focused on energy efficiency.

services.page_subtitle: Comprehensive technical solutions for every stage of your project.
services.electrical_desc: Design, installation, and certification of low, medium, and high voltage electrical systems. Compliance with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and local regulations. Distribution panels, LED lighting, grounding, and backup power systems.
services.hvac_desc: Design and installation of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems for commercial, industrial, and data center spaces. Energy optimization, industrial refrigeration, and precision ductwork.
services.automation_desc: Implementation of PLCs, SCADA systems, industrial networks (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP), and control panels. Integration of sensors and actuators for efficient production processes.
services.mechanical_desc: Installation of potable water piping, wastewater systems, fire suppression systems (NFPA 13), and pumping equipment. Certified welding and mechanical structure assembly.
services.maintenance_desc: Predictive and preventive maintenance programs for electrical equipment, motors, transformers, and HVAC systems. We reduce downtime and extend the service life of your assets.
services.management_desc: Comprehensive technical direction of electromechanical works: planning, budgeting, subcontractor coordination, quality control, and delivery of complete as-built documentation packages.
services.why_exp_desc: Over 20 years executing highly complex projects in the sector.
services.why_cert_desc: Engineers certified under CFIA, ASHRAE, NFPA, and NEC.
services.why_comp_desc: We deliver on time with complete as-built documentation.
services.why_guar_desc: Post-construction support and long-term maintenance programs.

projects.page_subtitle: A showcase of our track record and technical capabilities.
projects.proj1_desc: Complete electrical installation for 45,000 m², centralized HVAC system, and lighting automation for 120 commercial units.
projects.proj2_desc: Automation of production lines with Siemens PLCs, control panels, and real-time SCADA monitoring systems.
projects.proj3_desc: 22-floor electrical system, 500 kVA emergency generator, NFPA 13 fire suppression, and integrated BMS.
projects.proj4_desc: Electrical, plumbing, and 80 kWp photovoltaic solar system installation for 200 housing units.
projects.proj5_desc: Industrial LED lighting, electric forklift installation, fire suppression system, and forced ventilation for 8,000 m².
projects.proj6_desc: High-efficiency HVAC, room automation (KNX), electrical installation, and hybrid solar system for 60 guest rooms.
